text:
erin (SRE): Heads up  we keep seeing postmortem tasks stall between Day 7 and Day 30. Suggest we make a lightweight "postmortem action ops playbook" so ownership and cadence are explicit.

luis (Eng): Agree. We also need enforced acceptance criteria before closing trackers (logs/dash link + test or runbook change).

maya (PM): For comms: 48h stakeholder note, weekly one-line updates while active, Day 30 summary, and Day 90 final status. Comms owner should be the PM or designated IC.

owen (oncall): Proposal for minimal playbook steps: 1) postmortem header YAML (id, severity, pattern, owner, backup, due_date, acceptance_criteria); 2) bot creates tracker GH issue; 3) bot pings #eng-oncall if unassigned after 48h and again at Day 7; 4) required evidence attached before close.

erin (SRE): Also want a small handoff handshake when IC rotates: outgoing IC leaves a 4-line summary + list of in-flight remediations; incoming IC ACKs and shadows for 24h. This reduces lost context.

luis (Eng): Can we standardize failure-mode tags (network/db/deploy/third-party/regression/config) to enable monthly trend queries? If we auto-label on GH from meta it will be easy to dashboard.

infra-bot: Prototype configured: will create infra/postmortem-<id> GH issue from metadata and add labels. Reminder jobs scheduled at 48h and Day 7.

maya (PM): Rotation change idea: 2-week IC blocks with last 48h for handoff and block overlap. Helps follow-through.

owen (oncall): I'll update the rotation doc and add the handshake checklist. Will open a PR and tag folks.

erin (SRE): Action items: erin to post YAML snippet in this thread, infra to finish GH template & bot, owen to update rotation doc, maya to draft comms bullets, luis to help auto-label logic. Target: PRs + prototype by end of week.

luis (Eng): One more: require owner + due_date in postmortem before publish. Bot can reject posting if missing.

erin (SRE): Agreed. I'll post the minimal YAML now and then schedule a 15-min sync to align. Thanks all.
